ext.financial.total_income.definition: Total income as published for a stated reporting period. A fact for a period, not a current attribute.

dyn.employer_reporting_unit.lower_middle.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's lower-middle pay quartile who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.38 = 38%), not a whole percentage; it is a composition share within a pay quartile, not a pay gap.
dyn.employer_reporting_unit.lower_middle.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female share within a pay quartile; the total-workforce share is a different population, so reuse would change meaning.

dyn.employer_reporting_unit.upper_middle.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's upper-middle pay quartile who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.25 = 25%), not a whole percentage; it is a composition share within a pay quartile, not a pay gap.
dyn.employer_reporting_unit.upper_middle.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female share within a pay quartile; the total-workforce share is a different population, so reuse would change meaning.

dyn.employer_reporting_unit.total_workfo.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's total workforce who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%), not a whole percentage; it is a workforce composition share, not a pay gap.
dyn.employer_reporting_unit.total_workfo.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female workforce composition share; ext.financial.revenue_band and the GPG concepts concern revenue bands and pay gaps, so reuse would change meaning. Owner is the reporting unit, not the business.

dyn.employer_reporting_unit.lower_quarti.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's lower pay quartile who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.75 = 75%), not a whole percentage; it is a composition share within a pay quartile, not a pay gap.
dyn.employer_reporting_unit.lower_quarti.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female share within a pay quartile; the total-workforce share is a different population, so reuse would change meaning.

dyn.employer_reporting_unit.upper_quarti.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's upper pay quartile who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.16 = 16%), not a whole percentage; it is a composition share within a pay quartile, not a pay gap.
dyn.employer_reporting_unit.upper_quarti.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female share within a pay quartile; the total-workforce share is a different population, so reuse would change meaning.

ext.licence.end_date.definition: Publisher-stated end of the licence, not the end of the business or all its claims.

ext.licence.start_date.definition: Publisher-stated commencement of the licence, not the business establishment or registration date.

dyn.employer_reporting_unit.reporting_na.definition: The employer name as stated by the employer reporting unit in its WGEA Gender Equality Reporting submission for the reporting year. This is the reporting label, not a verified legal name or trading name, and is not a unique identifier.
dyn.employer_reporting_unit.reporting_na.why_not_existing: entity.legal_name and entity.trading_name are owned by business and assert a legal/trading status this source does not establish; the value here is a reporting-unit label for a WGEA submission, so owner and meaning differ.

ext.financial.taxable_income.definition: Taxable income for the period. Missing is not zero.

ext.contact.phone.definition: Phone number normalised to E.164 (+61...). Numbers shorter than 8 digits or without an area code are rejected. Mobiles are personal data unless published as a business line.

ext.entity.operating_region.definition: Where the business says it operates (service footprint), not where it is registered.

entity.abn.definition: Australian Business Number. Has a checksum — validate it, do not just length-check.

entity.acn.definition: Australian Company Number. Also checksummed. The last 9 digits of an ABN are often the ACN, but not always.

ext.entity.former_name.definition: A legal name the business held before its current one. Use valid_from/valid_to paths when the source dates the name. Never a trading name.

ext.entity.address_point.definition: lat,lon of the business's OWN stated address (e.g. a licensee's business address). A premises or site location is ext.establishment.geo on an establishment role instead.

ext.financial.revenue_band.definition: A revenue/turnover band from a named scheme (acnc_size_2022, qbcc_mfr). The value must be a label of that scheme's crosswalk table; band thresholds live in the table, not in the claim.

dyn.employer_reporting_unit.reporting_ab.definition: The ABN the employer reporting unit used to identify itself in its WGEA Gender Equality Reporting submission. It is a reporting identifier for the reporting unit and does not by itself establish legal form or company-wide scope.
dyn.employer_reporting_unit.reporting_ab.why_not_existing: entity.abn is owned by business and asserts the ABN of the business legal person; here the ABN is the reporting unit's submission identifier, so owner and scope differ even though the value format is the same.

dyn.employer_reporting_unit.size_band.definition: The employer size range band reported for the WGEA submission, expressed as an employee-count band such as '<250', '250-499' or '5000+'. The band set is publisher-defined and open-ended at the top; it is a band, not an exact headcount.
dyn.employer_reporting_unit.size_band.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents an employer headcount band; ext.financial.revenue_band is a revenue band under a named scheme and is not an employee-count band, so reuse would change meaning.

entity.legal_name.definition: As registered. Not the trading name.

ext.licence.status.definition: Licence status as published (licence status, not company status).

ext.entity.date_established.definition: Founding / establishment date. Not a registration date.

ext.establishment.capacity.definition: Published maximum patron count or similar capacity.

entity_types.business: The source's business/legal-person subject; legal form remains unknown unless stated.
entity_types.licence: An authorisation held by a business.
entity_types.establishment: A physical operating facility, separate from its operator.
entity_types.employer_reporting_unit: An employer reporting unit that submits WGEA Gender Equality Reporting results for a reporting year, identified by its reporting ABN; its legal form and company-wide scope are not established by this source.

retrieval: Lexical shortlist only; reuse requires identical meaning, owner, units and scope. Missing candidates can be requested with a narrower task.
